title: Kennedys Join Suit to Block Trump’s Arch, Saying It Would Mar J.F.K. Gravesite
summary: The legal filing argues that the arch would cast a shadow on Kennedy family graves and disrupt the sightline from the eternal flame memorializing the former president.
body_markdown: The legal filing argues that the arch would cast a shadow on Kennedy family graves and disrupt the sightline from the eternal flame memorializing the former president.
